ReleaseNotes: Added future-dated Daily Assignments so Dispatch can prepare work for upcoming weekdays, weekends, and overtime.
Made Truck Board technician and crew arrangements date-specific so planning one day cannot overwrite another day.
Added previous-day, today, next-day, and calendar navigation to Daily Assignments and Truck Board.
Updated only the Lineman Tasks view so Other Assignments is the primary work area while preserving the existing Field Technician layout.
Added Range Extender Site Dashboard access for Linemen, including the Equipment tab for Range Extender sites.
Added a dedicated Bug / Feature Request recipient setting while preserving delivery to the main email recipient.
Fixed Site Dashboard tabs so manually entered IP addresses, ping results, and unsaved write-ups remain isolated to their original site tab.
Added automatic Parent DB recovery after temporary network interruptions and structured API diagnostics logging.
Added Administration System Health monitoring for the API, SmartGridSuite database, Parent DB connectivity, fallback cache, encrypted backups, and server storage.
Added encrypted nightly SmartGridSuite backups with retention, integrity checks, restore verification, and failure notifications.
